question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'being'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a noun that can be defined by the **preceding adjective unique**. It should also correlate to the concept of *man. *
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options (all of which are nouns) - 
 
 
• organism - an individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form.
 
• being - the nature or essence of a person.
 
• cripple - a person with a severe limitation of a specified kind.
 
• stance - the way in which someone stands
 
 
 
• From the above-listed usage, we can conclude that being is the most appropriate option to fill in **blank number 5.**
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. 

Correct passage__ - *Novelists when they write novels tend to take an almost god-like attitude (1) __towards__ their subject, pretending to have a total comprehension of the story, a man's life, (2) __which__ they can therefore recount as God Himself might, nothing standing between them and the naked truth, the entire story meaningful in (3) __every__ detail. I am as little able to do this as the novelist is, even though my story is more important to me than any novelist's is to him – for this is my story; it is the story of a man, not of an invented, or possible, or idealized or otherwise (4) __absent__ figure, but of a unique (5) __being__ of flesh and blood. *
